integrity: The rank criterion is proved from the finite extension recursion; all 65,536 four-by-four matrices were enumerated and cross-checked against a separate direct recursion and a separate Burnside fixed-point enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exhaustive only for the first possible eight-vertex order; larger rank-three strata and rank-four cases are not classified. Historical priority remains provisional. All computational claims use self-contained source and recorded outputs; independent external mathematical verification has not been performed.
title: Sharp eight-point rank-three onset and full extremal census in two-sorted bipartite graphs
